content.text: Welcome to the Guardian Island world!
Did you come here to become|a Dynamon Captain?
Let's start by testing your SKILLS!
NICE! you have great potential.|Now choose your own Dynamon!
Great choice, you will make a great team!
Now, I have something to give you...
These ITEMS will be useful in your journey.
Speaking of which,|let's find a WILD DYNAMON...
Let's find some wild|Dynamons to BATTLE!
WAIT! Now that it's weak, let's|try to CATCH it!
WOW! Your Dynamon can LEVEL UP!
We use SHARDS to do that.|Use some now!
You can SWITCH Dynamons during battle.
Let's use the Duxedo you just caught!
That's Sofia, she is a trainer like you...
Go and BATTLE her!
During battles, you can use one ITEM per turn.
Use the SKILL CAN you just got!
Dynamons and Skills have TYPES...
Use the STRONG type when possible!
WOW, you're STRONG!|But I'm stronger!
Next time i won't lose!
You got access to a new location.
Let's go there!
Hi! My name is Julian...
Let's practice our battle technique!
Maybe I'm too old for this...
Great adventure ahead, | stay safe, my dear.
We made it to the Guardian island!
SUMSUM said he needed all the Guardians|to open a gate on this island.
Dr. Swan, look at that giant skull! Could that|be the gate SUMSUM was looking for?
But how did SUMSUM open the gate?
I can tell you more about the skull gate.|I remember it from my childhood stories.
My father once told me a scary story|at the campfire.
He spoke of a sacred tomb, where the|Legendary Guardian king Dynamon was buried.
This tomb was hidden somewhere in the|mountain of the Guardian island.
I remember more from the story now! The|Gate Keeper would scare anyone|away from the tomb entrance.
Anyone who dared to enter the skull gate without his|blessing would be turned into a spirit!
So it seems we need to find this Gate Keeper.
And we need to make sure we get his|blessing before entering the gate.
I feel so strange.
Dr. Swan, look! Could this be a spirit?
If this guard became a spirit, then it means|he failed to get the blessing from the Gate Keeper.
Wait? Am I dead?|Why do I look so weird?
Is this really happening? I can still|command my Dynamons even when I am dead?
Spirit Guard, could you tell us what happened to you?
The last thing I remember was following|SUMSUM through the skull gate.
But the gate keeper used a staff on me and|he changed me into a spirit!|What did I do wrong?
Spirit guard, what did the gate keeper look like?
The only thing I remembered is that he|had glowing yellow eyes.
I feel so light. It feels like I am floating!
Maybe this spirit can tell us some|more about the Gate Keeper?
Raider spirit, what is the last thing you remember?
Manifesto said there was nothing to be|afraid of. All I had to do was test if I|could enter through the skull gate.
Manifesto is also here?|That is bad news! I will call|the Elite team for help!
We will worry about Manifesto later!|Raider spirit, can you tell us some more|about the Gate Keeper?
He was wearing ancient clothing|and he had scary looking teeth.
I found the Elite team and|told them everything we know!
I am not afraid of spirits!
I don't want to get turned into a spirit!!!
Stop being a wuss and behave|like a real man!
I have a personal score to settle|with that traitor Manifesto! Let me|deal with him!
In the meantime my Elite team|will help you to find the Gate Keeper.
Somebody help me!
I recognize that sound.
Son, do you hear me?
Is that the sound of my father?
Father, is that really you?
I am sorry son. The gate keeper challenged|me to a Guardian quest, but I failed this quest.
No Father, this can't be!| What can I do to save you?
I can feel that my soul is inside that|Guardian tomb mountain.
The Elite team will pass the|Guardian quests and we will save your soul|from the Guardian Tomb!
Christos, do you remember how you|got the Gate Keeper to appear?
Yes, meet me up ahead and|I will tell you what you need to do.
There are 7 phrases to make the Gate Keeper|appear. I know 1 to do it!
Defeat my spirit Dynamons in a battle, and I will say it!
Golden Elite, this is our chance to make the|Gate Keeper appear!
Say the name Darkunaryx and challenge|the Gatekeeper for the Dark blessing.
Gate Keeper we challenge you|to use Darkunaryx in battle!
You did it! I can hear the Gate Keeper coming!
Who dares to make me appear?
I am the Gate Keeper that protects the|entrance gate from the Guardian King Tomb.
Only those who pass my 7 Guardian tests| will get my 7 blessings to enter the gate.
But beware! If you enter the gate without|all 7 blessings, your soul will be mine!
Let's see if you are worthy of the|Dark Guardian blessing!
To get the blessing from the Dark Guardian,|you have to defeat me in a battle.
You can't use any items.
Proof to me that you are worthy of the|Dark Guardian blessing.
Watch out! The Gate Keeper|is very strong in battle!
Hereby I grant you the blessing|from the Dark Guardian.
Meet me again, when you are ready|for the next Guardian test.
No don't go away Gate Keeper!|I need to challenge you to save my father!
Don't worry son! The Golden Elite can save|my soul! Please help him to get|all the 7 blessings.
I will do everything I can to save you father!
Let's find out who else knows how we|can make the Gate Keeper appear again.
Jenni? What are you doing here|on the Guardian Island?
My boyfriend Chuk said he would impress me|and give the best birthday gift ever.
Chuk said he would need 1 day on the|Guardian Island and be back on|time for my birthday.
Chuk did not return home for 3 days now.|He even missed my birthday!
I am so worried! Chuk is in trouble!|He would never miss my birthday!
Jenni, calm down.|We will find Chuk for you!
I feel so ashamed. I promised Jenni I would be|back on time for her birthday.
Chuk? Is that really you?|How did you become a spirit?
That dirty Gate Keeper! He tricked me!
He said if I could beat him in a quest,|that I would get a blessing medal.
I wanted to impress Jenni with a|blessing medal for her birthday.
But I lost the battle against the|Gate Keeper and he took my soul!
Could you please tell Jenni I am sorry|that I missed her birthday!
Jenni was very worried about you Chuk!|I will let her know what happened.
Chuk, with your help we can save your soul!
Tell me what I need to do?
Chuk, how did you make the|Gate Keeper appear?
Oh that was simple. Ruby sold me the secret |in return for something she wanted.
Ruby said I could make the Gate Keeper appear|when fighting a spirit if I say a secret phrase.
Chuk, you are spirit! Can we|try the secret phrase with you?
Oh right... I am a spirit now.|Give it a try it with me!
Say the name Aqonaryx and challenge|the Gatekeeper for the Water blessing.
Gate Keeper we challenge you|to use Aqonaryx in battle!
I think it worked!|I can hear the awful Gate Keeper coming!
Who dares to make me appear?
Oh so the Golden Elite has returned? Do|you dare to challenge me for a second|guardian test?
Let's see if you are worthy of the|Water Guardian blessing!
To get the blessing from the Water Guardian,|you have to defeat me in battle without|using any items.
Proof to me that you are worthy of the|Water Guardian blessing.
Come on! Knock him out!|I want to get my soul back!
Hereby I grant you the blessing|from the Water Guardian.
I will now return inside the Guardian tomb cave,|until I am called again.
We did it! We got another blessing medal!
I thought that battle would save my soul.
Chuk, we need 5 more blessing medals to save|the souls from you and Christos.
In that case...  I know a spirit that|might be able to help you!
I know a spirit that found a way|to make the Gate Keeper appear!
Sorry Klaude! I let the Elite team down.
Earth Elite? What did you do? I did not give you|permission to challenge the Gate Keeper!
But I had to do it! I needed to save my father!
Son! I am so happy to see you again!|But who will save us now?
Klaude, please save me and my father!
Earth Elite, what did you do to make|the Gate Keeper appear?
Meet up ahead and I will share how I did it.
I went to see Ruby and I traded something|she needed to get the secret.
This is the second time we hear Ruby knows|how to make the Gate Keeper appear.
I don't trust Ruby, she must be up to something!
Ruby said I could make the Gate Keeper appear|with this phrase.
Say the name Eartharyx and challenge|the Gatekeeper for the Earth blessing.
Gate Keeper we challenge you|to use Eartharyx in battle!
The secret phrase worked! Look! The Gate|Keeper is coming out of the Guardian tomb now!!
What? That Golden Elite again! Who shared|the secret to make me appear?
I will deal with that person later! Let's see if you|are worthy of the Earth Guardian blessing!
To get the blessing from the Earth Guardian,|you have to defeat me in battle without|using any items.
Watch out Golden Elite! The gate keeper took|my soul, when I lost the battle against him!
Hereby I grant you the blessing|from the Earth Guardian.
Now I will deal with the one who was sharing|my secrets! Her soul will be mine!
Oh no! Ruby is going to be in trouble!
I have a special secret to sell on|how to make the Gate Keeper appear!
Ruby, you are in great danger!
Danger? I am not worried. No one can steal|the secret info from me.
Ruby, name your price!|I will buy the secret info from you!
There is that traitor that is selling my secrets.|Ruby, your soul will be mine!
What just happened?|I feel so strange.
Oh no! Ruby just got turned into a spirit!
Oh great, I just lost my chance|to buy the secret from Ruby.
Sorry Dr. Swan. I was stubborn. I thought I could|get away with selling the Gate Keeper's secrets.
But maybe I can make a different deal with you?
I will tell you the secret phrase to make|the Gate Keeper appear if you can|save my soul in return?
Ofcourse Ruby.|We will save your soul!
You can make the Gate Keeper appear|when fighting me.
Golden elite, are you ready?
Say the name Embaryx and challenge|the Gatekeeper for the Fire blessing.
Gate Keeper we challenge you|to use Embaryx in battle!
I hear the Gate|Keeper coming!
If you can defeat the Gate Keeper,|I will tell you 1 more secret for free!
I can't believe it! That traitor Ruby is still giving|my secrets away even as a Spirit!
To get the blessing from the Fire Guardian,|you have to defeat me in battle without|using any items.
Hereby I grant you the blessing|from the Fire Guardian.
You are out of luck now. Ruby does not know|the other secret phrases to make me appear.
But I do know something else!|Meet me up ahead.
As a treasure hunter I was looking in all|worlds for hidden treasure.
While searching in Klaude's castle for a|hidden treasure, I found an ancient scroll.
The scroll contained a story of an old|castle lord that once lived in it.
Stop it Ruby! I will not allow you to tell|what was on that ancient scroll!
Stop it Ruby! Don't tell what|was on that ancient scroll!
The scroll speaks of the Dark Castle|in which an old castle lord once lived.
Wait, you mean Klaude's castle used|to be called the Dark Castle?
Okay I admit it. But I found the castle first!|So the castle was mine to claim!
That old castle lord was dead according to the scroll.|There is nothing he can do about it now!|The castle is mine!
Klaude, I have some bad news for you.|I know who that old castle lord is!
Who is that foolish guy that named|my castle to Klaude's castle?
Klaude, you will have to pay with|your soul for taking my castle!
Klaude, I tried to warn you! But the old castle|lord is the Gate Keeper!
Nooooooo! This was not supposed to happen!|The dirty Gate Keeper took my soul for taking|his empty castle!
Oh no! Our leader has been turned into a spirit!
Mwhahah! One day I will reclaim my castle back|and call it the Dark Castle again!
However there is a curse on my soul.
As long as the Guardian King remains in its tomb|I need to accept anyone who challenges me|for a Guardian blessing.
I will need to return back|to the Guardian Cave Tomb now.
Ruby, got the secret phrases on how|to make the Gate Keeper appear from the ancient scroll.
I could only remember 2 phrases from the|Ancient scroll, but a raider stole the scroll from me.
I still remember 1 phrase from the ancient scroll|for the Electric Guardian blessing!
You can make the Gate Keeper appear with my help.
Golden elite, are you ready?
Say the name Evoltonaryx and challenge|the Gatekeeper for the Electric blessing.
Gate Keeper we challenge you|to use Evoltonaryx in battle!
It seems I remembered the phrase from|the ancient scroll correctly! The Gate Keeper is coming!
This Klaude guy even annoys me as a spirit!
To get the blessing from the Electric Guardian,|you have to defeat me in battle without|using any items.
Hereby I grant you the blessing|from the Electric Guardian.
Curious to see how you will make me|appear without the ancient scroll mwhahah.
Look! I see a Raider spirit! Maybe|he knows more about that ancient scroll!
Dr. Swan, allow me to take care of this.|Raider, do you remember why you got|turned into a spirit?
It was Manifesto's fault! He was obsessed|with some ancient scroll. He asked me|to steal it for him!
I managed to steal the ancient scroll from Ruby|and bring the scroll to Manifesto.
Manifesto said he put my reward for stealing|the scroll inside the Guardian Tomb.
But when I entered the Guardian Tomb entrance,|the gate keeper appeared and he took my soul!
Raider, we can save your soul|if you can tell us where the scroll is?
I don't want to be saved!|I want my revenge on Manifesto!
Raider, I think we can both help each other!
Raider, I have plan! Do you think you|can get Manifesto back to our location?
Sure, I can pull Manifesto into your direction!
Manifesto, the spirits are coming for you!
Go away evil spirit!
Remember me Manifesto!
Stop pulling on me! Let me go!
What just happened? I was about to|get the last Guardian blessing!
This spirit just pulled me here!
Great work Raider. Now it is time|for part 2 of our plan!
Raider, do you want to get your|revenge on Manifesto?
I hate Manifesto! I want my revenge!
Dr. Swan, tell me how can I get my revenge?
Raider, Manifesto has an ancient scroll!|We need your help to steal it!
Raider, the Golden Elite will challenge|Manifesto for a battle.
At that moment Manifesto will be|distracted during the battle.
That will be my moment to steal|the ancient scroll from him!
Manifesto, the Golden Elite wants to|challenge you for a battle!
Can't you see that I am busy? I am preparing|for my next battle against the Gate Keeper!
Manifesto, that sounds like an excuse!|Are you afraid to lose against the Golden Elite?
What??!!! You think I am scared to lose!|Golden Elite, I accept your challenge!
Keep Manifesto busy. I see the|ancient scroll in his pocket.
Just need to get a little bit closer.|I almost have the ancient scroll!
I got the ancient scroll! Dr. Swan the scroll is yours now!
What is going on here?|I got stolen by a raider!
Raider, you are supposed to work for me!
Manifesto, you lied to me! You tricked me|into entering the Guardian Tomb cave without|getting the Guardian blessings!
Hahah that raider was so easy to fool!
Manifesto, you won't be able to|use that scroll anymore!
I don't need the scroll anymore.|I still remember what was written on it!
Say the name Daimoryx and challenge|the Gatekeeper for the Diamond blessing.
Gate Keeper we challenge you|to use Daimoryx in battle!
So what does the ancient scroll say?
Dr. Swan, I have read the ancient scroll and|I found the phrase to make the|Gate Keeper appear for the diamond blessing!!
You can make the Gate Keeper appear| with this secret phrase
I want to help! Fight with me!
It worked! The gate keeper just came out|of the Guardian Tomb cave!
I see you have something that belongs to me!|Return the ancient scroll or pay with your soul!
But first I must accept your challenge!
To get the blessing from the Diamond Guardian,|you have to defeat me in battle without|using any items.
Hereby I grant you the blessing|from the diamond Guardian.
I made a deal with Ferguson. In exchange for his|soul, you can keep my ancient scroll.
Don't worry about me! I had to sacrifice|my soul for the greater good!
Ferguson, that was... very brave!
We only need 1 more Guardian|blessing! We will save Ferguson's soul soon!
Thanks to our brave Ferguson, we were|still able to keep this ancient scroll.
The ancient scroll seems to contain 3 riddles.|I think this could be the secret phrase|we are looking for!
Did you say riddles?|Let me help you to solve it!
For the first riddle is says:|Which Dynamon is huge, but has small arms?
Let me think about this one!
Znarlyx is big and has small arms.
But Draxygus is also big with small arms,|could it be this one?
I have one more idea! How about this one?
I know the answer now! The only blessing|you still need is the gold blessing.
So the question is which gold Dynamon|is huge and has small arms?
The answer is Tyrexar!
Nice work Dom! You are really|good at solving riddles.
Time for the second riddle.
Riddles? I love riddles!|Let me help you dear.
The second riddle according to the ancient scroll is:|Which Dynamon does not stand on his arms or legs?
Ohhh I think I know what it is!
Scarykin does not have arms or legs.|He has wings!
No Helga. It needs to be a Gold type!
Then it has to be Pterodanox!|It is a gold type with wings.
No Helga! Pterodanox has legs!
Oh silly Helga. Let me try|one more time!
Cobragora does not have arms or legs.|It has a tail!
Amazing Helga! You solved the riddle!
Oh come on! I knew the answer|from the first moment!
Dom, do you think you are smart|enough to solve the last riddle?
Which Dynamon has no heart?
Uhhhm.. I think... that could be...
Then it is cybeenyx! A robot|does not have a heart!
Dom, that is not a gold type,|but an electric type!
Uuuummhh you are right Helga. |Let me think...
The answer was knightanyx right?
Dom, knightanyx is alive and has a beating heart!
But then what is it?????!!!!|I only have one last guess left...
Oh wait! Ofcourse! The only correct answer is...
That was a trick question! When Goldonyx changes|to Skulldonyx, that is the moment when|no heart is inside the Dynamon!
Hihi that took you long|enough to figure out Dom.
Amazing Dom! You solved the last riddle!
Ferguson spirit, I call upon you!
Dr. Swan, I am here! How can I help?
Ferguson, thanks to your bravery we were|able to solve the riddle on the ancient scroll!
Does the riddle explain how to|make the gate keeper appear?
Yes it did! According to the riddle|we can make the Gate Keeper appear|when doing the following:
We need to utter these names during the battle:|Tyrexar, Cobragora, Skulldonyx.
Let me help you! I'm a spirit now.|Say the secret phrase while fighting me!
Say the name Golunaryx and challenge|the Gatekeeper for the Gold blessing.
Gate Keeper we challenge you|to use Golunaryx in battle!
It worked! The gate keeper|is coming this way!
I see you managed to solve the|riddles from my ancient scroll.
That means I must accept your challenge!
To get the blessing from the Gold Guardian,|you have to defeat me in battle without|using any items.
Hereby I grant you the blessing|from the gold Guardian.
Congratulations you have been blessed|7 times by the Guardians now.
But I must warn you. You are not the first|to have obtained 7 blessings.
Dr. Swan, I know who it is!|Manifesto also has all 7 blessings!
Mwhahah! You can't stop me now!|I will enter the Guardian Tomb first!
So that annoying Golden Elite also|has received the 7 blessings!
Those 7 blessings won't help you,|because I will reach the Guardian Tomb first!
But I already came up with a|brilliant plan to stop you!
Manifesto gave me an offer I can't refuse!|I will defeat this Golden Elite right now!
Golden Elite, watch out! Manifesto will|reach the Guardian Tomb first!
I lost? From this Golden Elite Guy!|That means I won't get paid by Manifesto!
